Projected CPQL — if calls get answered
~$359
Modeled, not tracked: if just half of the 4 missed unique callers had qualified (3 → 5 qualified leads at the same spend). We can't verify — unanswered calls leave no conversation to review — and the true figure could be lower still.

Why this compounds inside Google's algorithm: Google's smart bidding learns from call outcomes. Calls that connect and run long register as conversions — talk time is a buying signal — so Google goes and finds more searchers who look like that caller. Unanswered and seconds-long calls register as non-conversions, teaching the algorithm that these searchers are the wrong audience, and it quietly shifts budget toward a different type of clicker. Every voicemail isn't just one lost lead — it's training data pushing the campaign away from the exact buyers it already found. Fixing answer rate doesn't just recover leads; it makes every future ad dollar smarter.

Priority Deal In Motion

Glendora Pool Remodel  NEEDS CONFIRMATION

Mary — Glendora, CA  ·  (626) 533-6121  Pool Remodel

Remodeling the pool at her rental property so a family friend can move in. Wants a smooth pebble finish (PebbleFina / mini pebble), keeping the existing tile and equipment. Pool is nearly drained and she wants it fixed as soon as possible.

"I'm down to nobody now." — after rejecting three competitors (cheap plaster pitch, a $14,000 cash-only demand, and one that doesn't install PebbleFina)

Timeline: Called Jun 12 (15-min conversation, estimate booked Jun 16 — missed due to a family emergency) → called back Jun 25 → estimate rescheduled to Jun 26, 11:00 AM. No call activity since.

Next Action Confirm the June 26 estimate visit happened and issue the proposal. She has rejected every competitor — this deal is BluePoint's to lose. Note: her phone doesn't accept voicemail; call ~30 min ahead, retry rather than leaving messages.

Recommendations

Five moves, in priority order
Confirm the Glendora estimate today. The ~$14K remodel has no remaining competitors. If the Jun 26 visit slipped, rebook immediately (call twice — her phone takes no voicemail).
Fix live answering during ad hours (see The #1 Opportunity above). Forwarding to a backup line or answering service during 8 AM – 6 PM would multiply lead volume at the same ad spend — and feed Google the talk-time conversion signals that make bidding smarter.
Call back (720) 856-9155 now and make same-hour callback the standard — the Jun 19 caller who opted out after a slow response shows the cost of waiting.
Shift budget toward "pool remodeling companies." It produced every qualified conversation this window; Custom Pools keywords ring the phone but haven't connected to a real conversation yet.
Route all ad calls through tracked lines. One 3m 20s call from the Jun 11 ad click never appeared in the CRM — likely a qualified lead lost to an untracked forwarding number.
